causes.name: Insufficient securities
causes.suggestedAction: Borrow or recall from stock-loan desk
causes.explanation: Counterparty did not have the shares available on settlement date. RBC has 1,200 shares on loan that can be recalled to cover delivery.

causes.name: SSI mismatch
causes.explanation: Counterparty BIC on our instruction does not match their standing settlement instructions on file. Their updated SSI was received 08-Oct.

causes.name: Late affirmation
causes.suggestedAction: Chase broker to affirm in CTM
causes.explanation: Trade was not affirmed by the broker before the cut-off. Affirmation usually lands within one business day once chased.

causes.name: Cash shortfall
causes.suggestedAction: Fund from sweep account or approve overdraft
causes.explanation: Cash in the settling account is below the amount due. The linked sweep account has sufficient balance to cover it.

causes.name: Unmatched instruction
causes.suggestedAction: Contact counterparty to match trade details
causes.explanation: No matching instruction from the counterparty at the depository. Usually caused by a booking delay on their side.

causes.name: Quantity / price mismatch
causes.explanation: Our booked quantity or price differs from the counterparty confirmation. Compare against the broker fill before amending.

causes.name: Corporate action pending
